shots.scene: 欣欣站在一条发光的DNA双螺旋和一面砖墙之间，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands between a glowing DNA double helix model and a sturdy brick wall, and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课：辐射怎样伤人，屏蔽怎样护人。
overlay: 辐射怎样伤人，屏蔽怎样护人

shots.scene: 左边DNA图标，右边盾牌图标，中间一个箭头
shots.prompt_en: A DNA helix icon on the left, a shield icon on the right, and an arrow pointing from the helix to the shield. No people.
shots.narration: 先看伤害从哪来，再学怎么挡住它。

shots.scene: 阿杰在放射实验室里，拿着一卷空白的金属箔，看着一个小屏蔽盒
shots.prompt_en: In a radiation lab, the young male student holds a roll of blank metal foil and looks at a small source container on a tray lined with absorbent paper.
shots.narration: 阿杰想用一层厚铅，把β源包严实。

shots.scene: 阿杰自信地竖起大拇指
shots.prompt_en: The young male student gives a confident thumbs-up with a big grin.
shots.narration: 他觉得：越重的材料越安全。

shots.scene: 小研戴着剂量计走来，摇头示意他停下
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student, wearing a dosimeter badge on her lab coat, walks over and shakes her head, signaling him to stop.
shots.narration: 小研摇头：这样反而会产生X射线。

shots.scene: 阿杰挠头，头顶冒出问号
shots.prompt_en: The young male student scratches his head with a question mark floating above him.
shots.narration: 阿杰糊涂了：辐射到底怎么伤人？

shots.scene: 欣欣在空白白板前竖起一根手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a blank whiteboard and raises one finger.
shots.narration: 我们从细胞里的DNA说起。

shots.scene: 一束射线穿过一个细胞，细胞里的小球被打出电子
shots.prompt_en: A beam of small arrows passes through a round cell; tiny electrons are knocked out of small balls inside it. No people.
shots.narration: 辐射靠电离能力，伤害活的组织。

shots.scene: 两条岔路通向同一个DNA图标
shots.prompt_en: Two forked paths, one straight and one winding, both lead to the same DNA helix icon. No people.
shots.narration: 伤害DNA，有两条路。

shots.scene: 一颗小炮弹直接撞上DNA梯子，梯子断开
shots.prompt_en: A small cannonball flies straight into a DNA ladder and snaps one of its rails. No people.
shots.narration: 直接作用：辐射直接打断DNA。

shots.scene: α粒子和快电子图标旁打着“密集”记号
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a heavy alpha particle ball and a fast electron dot, each leaving a dense trail of sparks. No people.
shots.narration: α粒子、快电子常这样伤人。

shots.scene: 细胞里装满水滴，闪电击中水滴，冒出带刺的小火星
shots.prompt_en: A cell filled with water droplets; a small lightning bolt hits a droplet and it releases spiky glowing sparks. No people.
shots.narration: 间接作用：先打碎细胞里的水。

shots.scene: 细胞剖面里约七成被蓝色水填满
shots.prompt_en: A cell cross-section where about seventy percent of the area is filled with blue water. No people.
shots.narration: 细胞里大约七成是水。

shots.scene: 带刺火星游向DNA并咬出缺口
shots.prompt_en: The spiky glowing sparks drift through the cell and bite small notches into a DNA ladder. No people.
shots.narration: 水变成的自由基，再去咬DNA。

shots.scene: X射线和γ射线波浪图标指向“间接”箭头
shots.prompt_en: Two wavy-line ray icons point to the winding path icon leading to the DNA. No people.
shots.narration: X射线、γ射线，主要走这条路。

shots.scene: 一颗保龄球冲过DNA梯子，沿路留下密集裂口
shots.prompt_en: A bowling ball rolls straight through a long DNA ladder, leaving a dense line of cracks along its path. No people.
shots.narration: 高LET辐射，像子弹一路密集撞击。

shots.scene: 放大镜下DNA梯子的扶手断开
shots.prompt_en: Under a magnifying glass, one side rail of the DNA ladder is physically broken. No people.
shots.narration: 梯子扶手，也就是骨架，被打断。

shots.scene: 放大镜下梯子的横档松脱
shots.prompt_en: Under a magnifying glass, a few rungs of the DNA ladder come loose and hang apart. No people.
shots.narration: 梯子横档，也就是碱基对，被拆开。

shots.scene: 一小段梯子上挤着好几处断口
shots.prompt_en: A short section of the DNA ladder has several breaks crowded closely together. No people.
shots.narration: 短短一段挤着多处断口，叫成簇损伤。

shots.scene: 细胞里的小修理工看着成团断口发愁
shots.prompt_en: A tiny cartoon repair worker inside a cell looks worried at the crowded tangle of breaks on the DNA ladder. No people.
shots.narration: 这种伤，细胞很难修好。

shots.scene: 梯子一侧扶手断了，另一侧完好
shots.prompt_en: A DNA ladder with only one side rail cut, the other rail intact. No people.
shots.narration: 只断一条链，叫单链断裂。

shots.scene: 小修理工照着完好的一侧把断口补上，打绿勾
shots.prompt_en: A tiny cartoon repair worker copies the intact rail and patches the broken rail; a green check mark appears. No people.
shots.narration: 照着另一条链当模板，就能补好。

shots.scene: 许多单链断口图标，几乎都打绿勾
shots.prompt_en: Many small single-break icons, almost all of them with green check marks. No people.
shots.narration: 每戈瑞每个细胞约一千个，几乎都能修好。

shots.scene: 梯子两侧扶手同一处都断，梯子断成两截
shots.prompt_en: Both rails of the DNA ladder are cut at the same spot and the ladder falls into two pieces. No people.
shots.narration: 两条链一起断，叫双链断裂。

shots.scene: 断成两截的梯子旁亮红色警示三角
shots.prompt_en: The two broken pieces of the DNA ladder with a red warning triangle icon beside them. No people.
shots.narration: 每戈瑞约四十个，却难修，最危险。

shots.scene: 红色警示三角指向一个死亡细胞和一个变色细胞
shots.prompt_en: The red warning triangle points to a shriveled dead cell and a cell with a strange color change. No people.
shots.narration: 细胞死亡和突变，多由它引起。

shots.section_title: 间接作用：水被打碎产生自由基
shots.scene: 第一格：射线击中水分子，打出一个电子
shots.prompt_en: Panel one of a three-panel comic: a ray hits a water molecule and knocks out a small electron. No people.
shots.narration: 第一步，射线把水分子电离。
overlay: 间接作用：水被打碎产生自由基

shots.section_title: 间接作用：水被打碎产生自由基
shots.scene: 第二格：带电的水分子裂开，冒出带刺火星
shots.prompt_en: Panel two: the charged water molecule splits apart and releases a spiky glowing spark. No people.
shots.narration: 第二步，裂开成活泼的自由基。

shots.section_title: 间接作用：水被打碎产生自由基
shots.scene: 第三格：火星在细胞里飘向DNA并咬出缺口
shots.prompt_en: Panel three: the spiky spark drifts across the cell and bites a notch in the DNA ladder. No people.
shots.narration: 第三步，自由基扩散，攻击DNA。

shots.section_title: 间接作用：水被打碎产生自由基
shots.scene: 医院拍片机图标旁的人体轮廓，体内散布小火星
shots.prompt_en: A simple medical X-ray machine icon next to a human body outline with tiny sparks scattered inside. No people.
shots.narration: 受X射线、γ射线照射时，

shots.section_title: 间接作用：水被打碎产生自由基
shots.scene: 饼图大部分标为间接作用
shots.prompt_en: A pie chart icon where the large majority slice is colored blue and the small slice orange. No people.
shots.narration: 大部分伤害来自这条间接途径。

shots.scene: 一排DNA损伤图卡：单断、双断、碱基坏、交联、成簇
shots.prompt_en: A row of five picture cards showing DNA ladders with different damage: one rail cut, both rails cut, a damaged rung, two rungs stuck together, and a tangle of breaks. No people.
shots.narration: DNA的伤，不只是断链。

shots.scene: 交联图卡放大：两段被粘连在一起
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a card where two strands of the DNA ladder are wrongly glued together. No people.
shots.narration: 还有碱基损伤，和链之间的交联。

shots.scene: 成簇损伤图卡旁出现保龄球图标
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of the tangled clustered-damage card with a small bowling ball icon beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 高LET辐射，更容易造成成簇损伤。

shots.scene: 阿杰在笔记本上画了一个星号
shots.prompt_en: The young male student draws a big star in his blank notebook during class.
shots.narration: 这是辐射生物学的重点。

shots.scene: 左边细胞亮着氧气小泡，右边细胞灰暗无氧
shots.prompt_en: Two cells side by side: the left one is full of small bright oxygen bubbles, the right one is grey with no bubbles. No people.
shots.narration: 细胞里有没有氧，伤害大不一样。

shots.scene: 氧气小泡像胶水，把DNA断口粘成一块硬疤
shots.prompt_en: A small oxygen bubble acts like glue and seals a DNA break into a hard permanent scar. No people.
shots.narration: 氧和自由基结合，把伤口“定型”。

shots.scene: 硬疤旁的小修理工无从下手
shots.prompt_en: A tiny cartoon repair worker tries to fix the hard scar but cannot. No people.
shots.narration: 定型的伤，就修不回去了。

shots.scene: 无氧细胞里两个断头重新接上，打绿勾
shots.prompt_en: In the grey oxygen-free cell, two broken DNA ends rejoin; a green check mark appears. No people.
shots.narration: 缺氧时，断头还可能自己接回。

shots.scene: 两个天平：缺氧那边要放更多砝码
shots.prompt_en: Two balance scales: to reach the same tilt, the oxygen-free side needs about three times more weights than the oxygen-rich side. No people.
shots.narration: 要造成同样伤害，缺氧细胞要更多剂量。

shots.scene: 细雨图标旁的砝码约三倍
shots.prompt_en: A light drizzle icon next to a stack of three weights versus one weight. No people.
shots.narration: X、γ射线下，约要2.5到3倍。

shots.scene: 保龄球图标旁两边砝码一样多
shots.prompt_en: A bowling ball icon next to two equal stacks of weights. No people.
shots.narration: 高LET辐射，有氧没氧差不多。

shots.scene: 肿瘤剖面：外层鲜红，核心灰暗
shots.prompt_en: A cross-section of a tumor lump: the outer layer is bright red with blood vessels, the core is grey and pale. No people.
shots.narration: 肿瘤核心常缺氧，更耐受放疗。

shots.section_title: 线性二次模型：细胞存活曲线
shots.scene: 一条从高处缓缓下弯、越往后越陡的滑梯曲线
shots.prompt_en: A playground slide shaped like a curve that starts gently from the top and gets steeper toward the end. No people.
shots.narration: 剂量越大，细胞存活越少。
overlay: 线性二次模型：细胞存活曲线

shots.section_title: 线性二次模型：细胞存活曲线
shots.scene: 两个旋钮图标分别贴着不同组织图标
shots.prompt_en: Two control knob icons, each attached to a different tissue icon: skin and lung. No people.
shots.narration: 曲线的形状，因组织而不同。

shots.section_title: 线性二次模型：细胞存活曲线
shots.scene: 老周在空白屏幕前给小研和阿杰讲解曲线
shots.prompt_en: The older man points at a blank screen showing only a curved line, explaining to the female graduate student and the young male student.
shots.narration: 它帮我们预测不同剂量下的组织损伤。

shots.scene: 一击就断的木棍
shots.prompt_en: A wooden stick snaps in one single hit from a small hammer. No people.
shots.narration: 一部分伤害，是一次击中就致命。

shots.scene: 小雨云图标下，存活曲线前段的直线部分发亮
shots.prompt_en: A slope icon labeled with a small drizzle cloud shows the straight early part of the curve glowing. No people.
shots.narration: 低剂量时，这一项占主导。

shots.scene: 两道轻微裂纹靠近后合成一道大裂缝
shots.prompt_en: Two small cracks on a wooden stick grow toward each other and join into one big break. No people.
shots.narration: 另一部分，是两处小伤叠成大伤。

shots.scene: 大雨图标下曲线后半段发亮
shots.prompt_en: A heavy rain cloud icon above the curve, with the steep later part of the curve glowing. No people.
shots.narration: 高剂量时，这一项占主导。

shots.section_title: α/β比：早反应与晚反应组织
shots.scene: 两个计时器：一个快沙漏，一个慢沙漏
shots.prompt_en: Two hourglasses: one with sand falling fast, one with sand falling very slowly. No people.
shots.narration: 组织有快反应，也有慢反应。
overlay: α/β比：早反应与晚反应组织

shots.section_title: α/β比：早反应与晚反应组织
shots.scene: 皮肤和肠道图标旁是快沙漏
shots.prompt_en: Skin and intestine icons next to the fast hourglass. No people.
shots.narration: 皮肤、肠道，α/β约10戈瑞，损伤很快出现。

shots.section_title: α/β比：早反应与晚反应组织
shots.scene: 脊髓和肺图标旁是慢沙漏
shots.prompt_en: Spinal cord and lung icons next to the slow hourglass. No people.
shots.narration: 脊髓、肺，约2到3戈瑞，损伤要数月数年。

shots.section_title: α/β比：早反应与晚反应组织
shots.scene: 一大块剂量被切成许多小块
shots.prompt_en: A large block is cut into many small equal slices, like a cake. No people.
shots.narration: 慢反应组织，怕单次大剂量。

shots.section_title: α/β比：早反应与晚反应组织
shots.scene: 一把尺子横跨两类组织图标
shots.prompt_en: A ruler stretched across the two groups of tissue icons. No people.
shots.narration: α/β比，就是衡量这种差别的尺子。

shots.section_title: 随机性效应与确定性效应
shots.scene: 左边一筐彩票，右边一个太阳和晒红的手臂
shots.prompt_en: On the left, a basket of lottery tickets; on the right, a bright sun and a sunburned arm. No people.
shots.narration: 辐射的健康效应分两类。
overlay: 随机性效应与确定性效应

shots.section_title: 随机性效应与确定性效应
shots.scene: 彩票越来越多，中奖概率上升，但奖品一样大
shots.prompt_en: More and more lottery tickets pile up and the chance meter rises, but the single prize box stays the same size. No people.
shots.narration: 随机性：剂量越大，发生概率越高，

shots.section_title: 随机性效应与确定性效应
shots.scene: 同一个奖品盒不变大
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of the same prize box, unchanged in size. No people.
shots.narration: 但发生后，严重程度和剂量无关。

shots.section_title: 随机性效应与确定性效应
shots.scene: 一个细胞变色后不断分裂成一团
shots.prompt_en: One cell changes color and keeps dividing into a growing cluster. No people.
shots.narration: 源头是单个突变细胞存活、增殖。

shots.section_title: 随机性效应与确定性效应
shots.scene: 太阳越来越强，手臂从微红到通红，起点有一道门槛线
shots.prompt_en: The sun grows stronger and the arm turns from slightly pink to deep red, with a threshold line marked at the start. No people.
shots.narration: 确定性：超过阈值才发生，越多越重。

shots.section_title: 随机性效应与确定性效应
shots.scene: 大片细胞同时倒下
shots.prompt_en: A large field of cells collapses at the same time. No people.
shots.narration: 源头是大量细胞死亡，组织修不过来。

shots.section_title: 线性无阈：没有绝对安全的剂量
shots.scene: 一条从原点出发的直线斜坡，起点没有台阶
shots.prompt_en: A straight ramp starting right from the ground, with no step at the bottom. No people.
shots.narration: 防护上假定：风险和剂量成正比。
overlay: 线性无阈：没有绝对安全的剂量

shots.section_title: 线性无阈：没有绝对安全的剂量
shots.scene: 斜坡最底端出现一个小警示三角
shots.prompt_en: At the very bottom of the ramp, a small warning triangle appears. No people.
shots.narration: 再小的剂量，也不当作零风险。

shots.section_title: 线性无阈：没有绝对安全的剂量
shots.scene: 日历一页页翻过多年
shots.prompt_en: Calendar pages flip quickly through many years. No people.
shots.narration: 实体瘤潜伏约5到30年，白血病短些。

shots.section_title: 线性无阈：没有绝对安全的剂量
shots.scene: 生殖细胞图标连到下一代婴儿图标，线条较淡
shots.prompt_en: A germ cell icon linked by a faint dashed line to a baby icon. No people.
shots.narration: 遗传效应可能存在，风险比致癌低。

shots.section_title: 线性无阈：没有绝对安全的剂量
shots.scene: 王老师在空白图表前用计算器估算
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator uses a calculator in front of a blank chart with a rising straight line.
shots.narration: 风险系数用来估算人群的癌症风险。

shots.section_title: 线性无阈：没有绝对安全的剂量
shots.scene: 两根柱子：工作人员和公众，高度相近
shots.prompt_en: Two bars of similar height, one with a worker icon and one with a family icon, next to a calculator. No people.
shots.narration: 工作人员约每希5%，公众约5.5%。

shots.scene: 人体轮廓上眼睛、皮肤、腰部、腹部四处亮起
shots.prompt_en: A simple human body outline with four spots glowing: the eyes, the skin of an arm, the lower body and the belly of a pregnant figure outline. No people.
shots.narration: 确定性效应，每个器官门槛不同。

shots.scene: 眼睛图标里晶状体变浑浊
shots.prompt_en: An eye icon whose clear lens slowly turns cloudy. No people.
shots.narration: 晶状体约0.5戈瑞，会逐渐得白内障。

shots.scene: 皮肤图标从发红到脱皮
shots.prompt_en: A skin patch icon turns red and then starts peeling. No people.
shots.narration: 皮肤约2戈瑞发红，15到20戈瑞湿性脱皮。

shots.scene: 生殖器官图标和胚胎图标亮起警示三角
shots.prompt_en: A reproductive organ icon and an embryo icon, each with a small warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 男性性腺约0.1戈瑞暂时不育，6戈瑞永久。

shots.scene: 胚胎图标亮起警示三角，旁边日历标出第2到7周
shots.prompt_en: An embryo icon with a small warning triangle, next to a calendar with weeks two to seven highlighted. No people.
shots.narration: 孕2到7周胚胎，约0.1到0.2戈瑞致畸风险增。

shots.section_title: 急性放射病的四个阶段
shots.scene: 人体轮廓被一大片强光短时间笼罩
shots.prompt_en: A human body outline is briefly flooded by a huge wave of strong light from all sides. No people.
shots.narration: 全身短时间受大剂量，会得急性放射病。
overlay: 急性放射病的四个阶段

shots.section_title: 急性放射病的四个阶段
shots.scene: 四格时间轴，第一格亮：恶心图标
shots.prompt_en: A four-step timeline; step one lights up with a nausea icon and a clock showing hours. No people.
shots.narration: 第一期：几小时内恶心、呕吐、乏力。

shots.section_title: 急性放射病的四个阶段
shots.scene: 第二格亮：人体轮廓看似正常，打问号
shots.prompt_en: Step two of the timeline lights up: the body outline looks normal, with a question mark beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 接着是潜伏期，好像好了，其实没有。

shots.section_title: 急性放射病的四个阶段
shots.scene: 第三格亮：骨髓、感染、出血图标
shots.prompt_en: Step three lights up with icons of bone marrow, germs and a blood drop. No people.
shots.narration: 几周后，骨髓衰竭、感染、出血。

shots.section_title: 急性放射病的四个阶段
shots.scene: 第四格亮：岔路，一边绿色康复一边灰色
shots.prompt_en: Step four lights up with a forked path: one branch green with a recovery heart, one branch grey. No people.
shots.narration: 最后康复或死亡，看剂量和救治。

shots.section_title: 急性放射病的四个阶段
shots.scene: 一摞档案盒和放大镜
shots.prompt_en: A stack of old archive boxes with a magnifying glass on top. No people.
shots.narration: 这些认识，多来自核爆和核事故。

shots.section_title: 急性放射病的三种类型
shots.scene: 一支温度计，从下到上分成三段颜色
shots.prompt_en: A tall thermometer divided into three colored zones from bottom to top: yellow, orange and dark red. No people.
shots.narration: 按剂量由低到高，分三种类型。
overlay: 急性放射病的三种类型

shots.section_title: 急性放射病的三种类型
shots.scene: 最下一段亮起骨头和血滴图标
shots.prompt_en: The bottom yellow zone lights up with a bone and blood drop icon. No people.
shots.narration: 造血型：约1戈瑞起，骨髓衰竭。

shots.section_title: 急性放射病的三种类型
shots.scene: 骨头图标旁一半人形变灰
shots.prompt_en: Beside the bone icon, half of a row of person pictograms turn grey, with a calendar showing sixty days. No people.
shots.narration: 不救治，半数60天内致死约6戈瑞。

shots.section_title: 急性放射病的三种类型
shots.scene: 中间一段亮起肠道图标
shots.prompt_en: The middle orange zone lights up with an intestine icon. No people.
shots.narration: 胃肠型：约15戈瑞，肠壁破坏，数周致死。

shots.section_title: 急性放射病的三种类型
shots.scene: 最上一段亮起大脑和心脏图标
shots.prompt_en: The top dark red zone lights up with a brain icon and a heart icon. No people.
shots.narration: 脑型：超过20戈瑞，数小时到数天致死。

shots.section_title: 急性放射病的三种类型
shots.scene: 欣欣严肃地摇头，身旁的医药箱灰暗
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot shakes its head seriously beside a greyed-out first aid kit icon.
shots.narration: 到了脑型，医疗干预也无效。

shots.section_title: 外照射防护：时间、距离、屏蔽
shots.scene: 欣欣站在三角形前，三角顶点是时钟、尺子、砖墙
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a big triangle with a clock, a ruler and a brick wall at its three corners.
shots.narration: 怎么保护自己？记住三招。
overlay: 外照射防护：时间、距离、屏蔽

shots.section_title: 外照射防护：时间、距离、屏蔽
shots.scene: 沙漏旁剂量计数字越积越多
shots.prompt_en: An hourglass next to a dose meter icon whose bar fills up as the sand falls. No people.
shots.narration: 时间：剂量和停留时间成正比。

shots.section_title: 外照射防护：时间、距离、屏蔽
shots.scene: 人往后退，篝火的热浪迅速变小
shots.prompt_en: A campfire icon with heat waves that shrink quickly as a footprint trail moves away from it. No people.
shots.narration: 距离：离远一倍，剂量剩四分之一。

shots.section_title: 外照射防护：时间、距离、屏蔽
shots.scene: 放射源和人形图标之间立起一面墙
shots.prompt_en: A wall rises between a small source container icon and a person-shaped icon. No people.
shots.narration: 屏蔽：在源和人之间放吸收材料。

shots.section_title: 散射让屏蔽后的剂量更高
shots.scene: 一束细手电光穿过一块玻璃，光束整齐
shots.prompt_en: A narrow flashlight beam passes cleanly through a thick block, staying neat and straight. No people.
shots.narration: 理想情况：一束细光穿过屏蔽体。
overlay: 散射让屏蔽后的剂量更高

shots.section_title: 散射让屏蔽后的剂量更高
shots.scene: 宽光束进入块中四处反弹，后方多出许多小箭头
shots.prompt_en: A wide beam enters the thick block, bounces around inside, and many extra small arrows come out behind it. No people.
shots.narration: 现实中，射线会在屏蔽里散射。

shots.section_title: 散射让屏蔽后的剂量更高
shots.scene: 两个剂量条：实际比估算高
shots.prompt_en: Two bar icons side by side behind the block: the measured bar is taller than the estimated bar. No people.
shots.narration: 厚屏蔽后，实际剂量总比简单估算高。

shots.section_title: 散射让屏蔽后的剂量更高
shots.scene: 阿杰看着实验曲线偏离预期，挠头
shots.prompt_en: The young male student looks at a blank lab chart where the plotted dots drift away from a straight line, and scratches his head.
shots.narration: 实验曲线对不上，常是散射在作怪。

shots.scene: 一张纸对折一次，光点亮度减半
shots.prompt_en: A sheet of paper is folded once, and a glowing light dot behind it becomes half as bright. No people.
shots.narration: 半值层：让射线减到一半的厚度。

shots.scene: 更厚的一块板，后面只剩一个小光点
shots.prompt_en: A thicker slab, with only one tenth of the light dots coming out behind it. No people.
shots.narration: 十值层：减到十分之一，约3.32个半值层。

shots.scene: 七块一样的薄板排成一排，光点越来越暗
shots.prompt_en: Seven identical thin slabs in a row; the light dot gets dimmer and dimmer after each one. No people.
shots.narration: 叠七个半值层，剩下不到百分之一。

shots.scene: 不同材料的板各自标着不同厚度
shots.prompt_en: Slabs of different materials of different thicknesses lined up for comparison. No people.
shots.narration: 用这些量，方便比较各种材料。

shots.scene: 一块薄铅板和一堵厚混凝土墙并排，挡住同样的射线
shots.prompt_en: A thin lead plate and a thick concrete wall stand side by side, each blocking the same ray arrows. No people.
shots.narration: 挡γ射线，铅最节省空间。

shots.scene: 铅板只有混凝土墙的约八分之一厚
shots.prompt_en: A thickness comparison: the lead plate is only about one eighth as thick as the concrete wall. No people.
shots.narration: 同样效果，铅约是混凝土厚度的八分之一。

shots.scene: 老李拍拍一堵高大的混凝土屏蔽墙
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer pats a tall, solid concrete shielding wall of a radiation facility.
shots.narration: 但混凝土结实，固定设施的墙用它。

shots.scene: 小球滚进沙地，滚一段就停下
shots.prompt_en: Small balls roll into a sandbox and each one stops after a short distance. No people.
shots.narration: β粒子不一样，它有最大射程。

shots.scene: 电子小球一路与材料里的电子云碰撞减速
shots.prompt_en: Small electron balls bump through clouds of electrons inside a block, slowing down step by step. No people.
shots.narration: 带电的它，一路碰撞，一路减速。

shots.scene: 一块足够厚的板后面没有小球穿出，打绿勾
shots.prompt_en: A slab thick enough that no balls come out the other side; a green check mark appears. No people.
shots.narration: 厚度超过射程，就能全部挡住。

shots.scene: β源被厚铅直接包住，铅块后射出X射线箭头，画红叉
shots.prompt_en: A beta source wrapped directly in a heavy lead block, with penetrating ray arrows shooting out behind it; the whole picture is crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 铅直接包β源，会产生轫致辐射。

shots.scene: 飞快的小车撞上铁墙，迸出火花
shots.prompt_en: A fast toy car crashes into an iron wall and throws off bright sparks. No people.
shots.narration: 就像急刹车，电子撞铅放出X射线。

shots.scene: 内层透明有机玻璃，外层薄铅，打绿勾
shots.prompt_en: A two-layer shield: a thick clear acrylic inner layer and a thin lead outer layer, with a green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 正确做法：内层先用有机玻璃挡住β。

shots.scene: 少量X射线箭头被外层薄铅挡住
shots.prompt_en: A few faint ray arrows escaping the acrylic are stopped by the thin outer lead layer. No people.
shots.narration: 外层再用薄铅，挡住少量X射线。

shots.scene: 小研把阿杰手里的金属箔放回架上，递给他透明屏蔽盒
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student puts the roll of blank metal foil back on the shelf and hands the young male student a clear acrylic shielding box.
shots.narration: 阿杰明白了：先轻后重，双层屏蔽。

shots.scene: 欣欣身边浮现DNA和盾牌图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a floating DNA helix icon and a shield icon.
shots.narration: 辐射直接或间接，伤害DNA。

shots.scene: 双链断裂和氧气小泡图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a DNA ladder broken in two and a small oxygen bubble. No people.
shots.narration: 双链断裂最危险，氧会加重损伤。

shots.scene: 彩票和晒红手臂图标并排
shots.prompt_en: A lottery ticket icon and a sunburned arm icon side by side. No people.
shots.narration: 随机性看概率，确定性有阈值。

shots.scene: 时钟、尺子、砖墙三个打勾图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons with green check marks: a clock, a ruler and a brick wall. No people.
shots.narration: 时间短、距离远、有屏蔽。

shots.scene: 有机玻璃加薄铅的双层图标
shots.prompt_en: A two-layer shield icon of clear acrylic inside and thin lead outside, with a green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: β先轻后重，双层屏蔽。

shots.scene: 温度计图标分三段
shots.prompt_en: A thermometer icon divided into three colored zones with a bone, an intestine and a brain icon. No people.
shots.narration: 急性放射病分造血、胃肠、脑三型。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在发光的DNA和砖墙前挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye at the camera in front of the glowing DNA helix and the sturdy brick wall.
shots.narration: 懂原理、会屏蔽，用好辐射！
